title: Usage Charge on Trial Refunds — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
A usage charge is taken from a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty trial refund, following how far and how long the set was used. The miles run are the odometer of the set's latest tread inspection entry less the install odometer, or 0 for a set with no tread inspection entry; the days kept are the calendar days from the install date to today.

| Use | Usage charge |
|---|---|
| miles run more than two thirds of the line's trial miles **and** days kept more than half of its trial days | the miles run times $0.005 times the tire count |
| not both of those, but miles run more than one third of the trial miles | $6.00 times the tire count |
| any other set | nothing |

| Line | Trial miles | Two thirds | One third | Half the trial days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 1,500 | 1,000.00 | 500.00 | 15 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 1,500 | 1,000.00 | 500.00 | 15 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 3,000 | 2,000.00 | 1,000.00 | 22.5 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 3,000 | 2,000.00 | 1,000.00 | 22.5 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 5,000 | 3,333.33 | 1,666.67 | 30 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 5,000 | 3,333.33 | 1,666.67 | 30 |

Trial miles in line order: 1500, 1500, 3000, 3000, 5000, 5000.

**Cases (hypothetical 4-tire sets on a 3,000-mile, 45-day line):** 2,400 miles, 30 days kept — 2,400 times $0.005 times 4, $48.00; 2,400 miles, 20 days — $24.00; 1,200 miles — $24.00; 900 miles — nothing.
